generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A terminal delivery certificate can become stale when code, tests, configuration, schema, or other material paths are written after the certified material freeze while the old result package remains published.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Treat an already published result-only certificate as permanently valid and continue changing material files without re-freezing the new material head and regenerating exact-head evidence.
trigger_signals: current head differs from the certified material head
current parent is not the certified material head
paths outside the result-only allowlist appear after certification
generalized_learning.reusable_control: Classify every post-certificate head transition before handoff; any material path or parent drift is a mandatory post-write-refreeze, never a handoff-only repair.
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: After a material freeze, do not publish or preserve a terminal handoff across any subsequent material write; re-freeze the latest material candidate first.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: At terminal handoff, compare the fresh remote head, its parent, and changed paths against the certificate material head and result-only allowlist; fail closed on any material drift.
